events.title_en: Satan hurled out of heaven down to the earth
events.description_en: Shortly after Jesus was installed as Messianic King in 1914, he and his angels warred against Satan and the demons and hurled them out of heaven down to the earth. Satan is now confined to the vicinity of the earth for a short time, venting his anger on God's people.
events.description_ta: பாம்பை, அதாவது சாத்தானை, இயேசு பூமிக்குத் தள்ளி, கொஞ்சக் காலம் அங்கே விட்டுவைத்திருக்கிறார்.—வெளிப்படுத்துதல் 12:7-9, 12.

sources.quote_en: Jesus hurls the serpent, Satan, to the earth, confining him there for a short time.—Revelation 12:7-9, 12.

sources.title_en: An Ancient Prophecy That Affects You
sources.quote_en: Shortly after Jesus was installed as Messianic King in 1914, Satan was cast out of heaven. He is now confined to the vicinity of the earth, awaiting his destruction. (Rev. 12:9, 12)

sources.title_en: An Ancient Prophecy That Affects You
sources.par: Box: Some Key Events in the Fulfillment of Genesis 3:15 (E)
sources.quote_en: ABOUT 1914 Satan is cast out of heaven, and persecution of the offspring of the woman intensifies. (Rev. 12:9, 12, 17)

sources.title_en: The Kingdom Is Born in Heaven
sources.quote_en: Satan and his demons warred against the faithful angels, who were under the leadership of Michael, or Christ.

images.caption_en: The serpent, Satan, being hurled to earth as promised in Revelation
images.caption_ta: வெளிப்படுத்துதலில் சொல்லப்பட்டபடி, ராட்சத பாம்பாகிய சாத்தான் பூமிக்குத் தள்ளப்படுகிறான்

events.notes: Added for the promised-offspring series (NWT App. B1 step 'About 1914 C.E.'). Dated 'about 1914' as B1 and w22.07 word it; it follows the Kingdom's birth (b10-0002) and precedes the 'woe' for the earth (b10-0003).
